newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Preliminary results of Chechen presidential poll.
newsitem.headline: Preliminary results of Chechen presidential poll.

text.p: Unofficial preliminary results of Chechnya's presidential election, based on 56 out of the total 63 districts, are as follows.
Under Chechnya's voting rules a second round of voting need not be held because the leading candidate won more than 50 percent of votes cast.
The Central Election Commission said the total number of eligible voters, including refugees, was estimated at 513,000.
It said the remaining seven electoral districts where votes were still being counted were sparsely populated rural areas that would make little difference to the final outcome.
Final results are not expected for several days.
The commission said counting of votes in the parliamentary election, which was also held on Monday, had not started.
It said that many districts would probably have to hold a second round on February 15. In the parliamentary election, too, candidates had to clear the 50 percent hurdle.
Maskhadov, if officially confirmed as the winner of the presidential poll, will be inaugurated in about two months, the commission said.
